# Dashboard data (generated by scripts/preprocess_spaces.py)

- `spaces.geojson` / `spaces.csv` — one row per public space (WGS84; geometry simplified to 1.5 m).
  Fields: id, name, city, category, owner (City/State/Private/Other public), private_owned,
  access (Y public, L limited, X unknown), year (acquisition year, Boston only), area_m2, area_acres,
  rank_all (area rank across the three cities), pop_500m / housing_500m (2020 census, blocks
  areal-weighted within 500 m of the space border), n_parts, source, lon, lat.
- `boundaries.geojson` — Boston, Cambridge, Somerville limits.  `water.geojson` — basemap water.
- `review/massgis_classification.csv` — every MassGIS polygon with the reason it was excluded.
- `review/municipal_gapfill.csv` — municipal polygons missing from MassGIS, with inclusion decision.
